content.what_it_is: Python flat-vessel wave plotting script that derives an output directory beneath the HOME environment path and loads eta_00001 to establish a unit-spaced grid (L9-L22), selects outputs 20 and 40 with second labels (L24-L25), creates two pcolor panels with ±1.5 limits, and saves eta_flat_vessel.png in the current working directory (L34-L53).

unresolved: Path/interface assumption at L11-L14: HOME must exist and contain one fixed FUNWAVE-TVD work-tree layout; there is no argument/configuration fallback or file-existence diagnostic.
Cross-file shape assumption across L14-L22 and L37-L41: coordinates are derived only from eta_00001, but selected eta arrays are not checked for matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and sec lists at L24-L25 are jointly indexed at L35 and L43 without an equal-length check; editing only one can make sec[num] out of range.
Matplotlib pcolor at L41 does not specify shading while x/y lengths match eta dimensions; behavior can vary by Matplotlib version between boundary truncation and automatic shading.
